nodes.label: Build & Release workflow (tag-triggered build/publish/reset)
nodes.rationale: Linux builds are static musl binaries so they run on both glibc and musl systems; platform packages are published to npm before the meta package so @perfscale/exe's optionalDependencies are resolvable the moment it lands.
